head_note: The head of Copilot's first review of the PR.
title: fix: fail a started Staff that never reaches Triglav and retry it once
notes_basis: The PR description as it is today, cut before its "Changes after review" section, which lists the fixes to the review findings. The baseline run of 2026-10-16 used the description without this cut, so its seats saw that section.
notes:
## Problem

The card for one job (unavailable owner) showed "Starting Staff..." for a long time and nothing recovered.

What happened, from the session transcript and the MCP log:

- The runner started `staff-req_<id>` at 23:09 on 2026-10-14 and reported `ok: backgrounded`.
- The `orchestrator` MCP server connected at 23:09:54.
- About 7 seconds later the session's first turn said it had no `get_guide` tool, and it went idle (`claude agents --json`: `status: idle`, `state: blocked`).
- The request stayed `started`. Nothing watched it, so the spinner and the unavailable-owner blocker stayed.

I did not find out why the tool was missing. A race between MCP startup and the first prompt is my guess and is not verified.

## Change

`failUnregisteredStarts` in `src/job-requests.ts` runs on every scheduler tick (`src/scheduler.ts`):

- A request still `started` 3 minutes after the runner's report, and never read by a Staff (`staff_agent_id` is empty), is set to `failed`. The error says the session did not read its job request.
- The same request is queued once more: `startStaffForJob` for a takeover, `retryJobRequest` for link and prompt requests.
- If the same request (same repo, job, prompt and source) already failed this way in the last 30 minutes, it is not retried. A persistent fault cannot start sessions in a loop, and the Client decides.
- `replace` requests are failed but not retried (the existing rule for replacements).
- Each request is locked and re-checked in its own transaction, so a Staff that registers at the same moment is not failed.

Effect on the dashboard: the spinner ends after 3 minutes and the card shows the error, so the Client can start a new Staff without waiting out the 10-minute window.

## Tests

- New test in `test/job-sources.test.ts`: no change at 2 minutes, failed and retried at 4 minutes, the retry fails and is not retried again.
- Fixed a stale expectation: `staff_start` launches carry `session_id: null`. That failure left a queued launch behind and broke the tests after it.
- `pnpm typecheck` passes. `pnpm test`: 209 passed, 1 failed. The failure is `does not use the enrollment key as its key` in `test/runner-security.test.ts` (20 s timeout). It fails the same way on the unchanged baseline.
